answer: Identity-bond decay stops bulk fake identities. Each agent locks a 60-credit bond losing 5 credits per epoch, like a cedar fence in an orchard that rots unless tended. Renewal needs real work from different counterparties, so a river of self-dealing trades cannot refresh it. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 credits, and bonds vanish after 12 epochs without work. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps rewards undiluted.
